scope.geometry: All currently visible geometry and exact instance matrices; no photograph or replacement geometry

excluded.reason: Non-PBR shader has no automatic portable equivalent

addedContext.geometry: 4vertices,2triangles; independent ground context, source visible meshes unchanged
addedContext.assumption: Unseen courtyard plane inferred below source low camera; not a measured floor from the close-up reference.

worldCoordinateConversion: All source meshes, lights and camera jointly rotated +90 degrees about X: Y-up to Z-up, no deformation.

outdoorSky.source: Blender atmospheric scattering, no bitmap background

materialTransfer: Original portable PBR parameters and source procedural textures; custom GLSL not portable. Planar approximations replaced by physical reflection.

vermilionAlbedoCalibration.materialScope: Original red lacquer / kit cedar only; source UVs and scanned albedo, normal and roughness maps retained

physicalSun.indirectLight: Cycles diffuse GI; WebGL directional bounce helpers omitted

lightCalibration.transfer: One source sun azimuth with calibrated elevation/energy; atmospheric sky and traced GI. Original portable PBR maps/UV preserved.
